visualCharacteristics.purpose: Related or partner brands: each column a brand logo linking to the brand site above a short description
visualCharacteristics.layout: White box with equal columns separated by a thin vertical rule from 600px; logo and copy centered; columns stack with a horizontal rule on small screens
visualCharacteristics.sourceSection: Related Brands (solutions.html), on a navy-to-blue gradient section with a centered heading above

contentPattern.structure: one row, one cell per brand: brand logo image (optionally linked to the brand site), description paragraph(s). Empty spacer paragraphs are removed

usage: Showcasing sister or partner brands with logo and blurb.
reuseGuidance: Use for logo-over-copy columns in a white box. For text beside a video use columns-video; for text beside a stat graphic use columns-stat; for a mixed media tile grid use columns-mosaic.
